title: The Warden, Freed
prompt: A loop with no ending condition — and one way out written inside it. Walk it with him, turn by turn.

steps.note: Before the first step. 'while True' will never stop on its own, so the ending must come from inside.
count was not 3, so the break was skipped and the tally rose.
Now it is 3 — but the check happens at the TOP of the next turn, not here.
The condition holds, break fires, and the loop lets go. count keeps the value it had.

config.success: Three, and then a door. An endless loop is only endless until something inside it decides otherwise.
